主要内容: The IVD market has seen significant M&A activity, with over 220 acquisitions from 2015 to March 2018. Companies are expanding into emerging technologies like gene editing, liquid biopsy, and microbiome research. LGC acquired Lucigen to enhance its NGS and gene editing capabilities. Danaher's acquisition of Cepheid enables it to pivot toward advanced diagnostics. Bio-Rad Laboratories strengthened its digital droplet PCR capabilities through RainDance Technologies. Enterome and Nestle Health Sciences formed a joint venture to develop microbiome diagnostics for inflammatory bowel disease and liver disorders. Siemens Healthineers acquired Conworx Technology to improve point-of-care informatics. PerkinElmer acquired Tulip Diagnostics, India's largest in-vitro diagnostic reagent provider. U.S. tax legislation is expected to support further M&A activity in the IVD sector.
